title: LernLab deck package manifest (.lernpack format version 1)
description: manifest.json at the root of a .lernpack zip (or inside its single top folder). See docs/FORMAT.md. Readers must ignore keys they do not know, so this schema allows additional properties.

version.description: Format version. This schema describes version 1. A reader refuses a package whose version is higher than the one it knows.

deck.description: The deck the cards belong to.

name.description: Deck name. Readers fall back to the file name when it is missing or empty.

language.description: Language code (de, ja, ko, fr, ...) for a language deck, or null for any other subject.

goal.description: Optional study goal, for example an exam and the number of words it needs.

label.description: Name of the goal, e.g. "Goethe B1".

words.description: Number of cards or words the goal needs.

tag.description: Tag that marks the cards counting towards the goal.

maps.description: Optional, added after v1 was published; older readers ignore it. The author's concept maps as plain text. A line starting with # opens a map and names its topic; each following line is one link, "Term --label--> Other term" (or "Term --> Other term"). At most 20 maps, 16 terms and 30 links per map, 6000 characters in all; a map needs at least two links. Readers skip lines they cannot read and remove any HTML.

cards.description: Number of cards in the package. Informational: readers count the cards file.

created.description: When the package was written (ISO 8601, UTC).

generator.description: The program that wrote the package, e.g. "LernLab".
